name: dynamic storage keeps JavaScript-owned array elements
source: function main(): void { const xs: {x: number}[] = []; const a: any = xs; const original: any = new Function("return {x: 1}")(); a[0] = original; console.log(a[0] === original, xs[0] === original); original.x = 7; console.log(xs[0].x); xs[0].x = 9; console.log(original.x); }
